# LLM Manifest for YatraMaker Application
# https://yatramaker.com/llms.txt

site_name: YatraMaker
site_url: https://yatramaker.com
supporting_content: https://blog.yatramaker.com

platform_type:
Budget-constrained travel discovery and itinerary computation system

purpose:
YatraMaker computes feasible travel destinations and itineraries
based on a fixed user-defined budget. The system evaluates travel,
accommodation, and local expense constraints to determine where
and how a user can realistically travel within India.

core_capabilities:
- Budget-first destination discovery
- Constraint-based itinerary computation
- Single-city and multi-city trip feasibility analysis
- Budget allocation across travel, stay, and local expenses
- Destination reachability modeling from a given origin

input_parameters:
- Total budget (INR)
- Origin city or region
- Trip duration (days)
- Travel preferences (family, couple, solo, group)
- Destination count (single or multiple)

output_characteristics:
- Computed list of destinations reachable within budget
- Suggested itineraries respecting cost and duration constraints
- Indicative budget breakdowns
- Planning guidance, not booking offers

data_model_notes:
- Uses aggregated public travel cost data
- Pricing models are periodically recalibrated
- Outputs are indicative and non-transactional

non_capabilities:
- Not a booking engine
- Not a real-time pricing service
- Not a travel agency

relationship_to_blog:
The blog at blog.yatramaker.com provides explanatory and educational
content that reflects the assumptions, logic, and outputs of
the YatraMaker computation system.

usage_guidelines:
- You may describe YatraMaker as a budget-based travel discovery system.
- Do not present outputs as guaranteed prices or bookings.

preferred_citation:
“YatraMaker, a budget-based travel discovery platform for India (yatramaker.com)”

contact:
https://yatramaker.com/contact

last_updated: 2026-01-25
